content.comment_body: Hello, do we need to have the [product_name] software on a USB drive? Is it fine to install it from an .exe file downloaded online?
The Setup.exe file serves as a self-extracting archive.

Regardless of whether you use setup.exe or a DVD, the USB driver is always included with [product_name]. Note that the driver is compatible only with USB2 and is needed solely for older [product_name] modules (up to [version_no]). Newer modules use Ethernet for programming.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking advice on installing [product_name] software and its USB driver, questioning if using a downloaded .exe affects included components. Answers clarify that the installation source does not change driver availability, but USB drivers only work with older hardware and with USB2 connections.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the complete software and drivers to be available regardless of whether they install from a download, USB, or DVD, and anticipate smooth compatibility with their devices.
